caseName: Board of Trade v. Christie Grain & Stock Co.
caseNameFull: Board of Trade of the City of Chicago v. Christie Grain and Stock Company

opinions.text: April 25, 1904. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit granted. Mr. Henry 8. Robbins for petitioner. Mr. James H. Harkless, Mr. Clifford Histed, Mr. W. H. Rossington and Mr. Charles Blood Smith for respondents.
